text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated 5xx rate observed from API gateway (edge) starting ~2026-03-15T02:13:00Z. Peak error rate 22% across prod edge. Alerting SRE oncall. dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/apigw/errors

alex.sre: oncall here, jumping in. tagging runtime + eng. starting quick triage.

jamie-eng: seeing a fanout of 502/504 across multiple edge nodes. traces show upstream timeouts to router-pool-v2 and a bunch of ECONNRESET from the edge->origin layer.

maria-runtime: logs look like upstream read timeout mostly, snippets:
```
[02:13:22] edge-node-7 proxy: upstream timed out (110) while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.4.2.53
[02:13:23] edge-node-5 proxy: recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading upstream
```

alex.sre: can someone run a healthcheck against origin pool? curl internal health endpoint across a handful of edges.

maria-runtime: running quick curl from edge-node-7:
```bash
curl -v http://10.8.12.33/healthz -H "Host: api.redwood" --max-time 2
* Connection timed out after 2000 milliseconds
```

jamie-eng: last deploy to edge routing config: 2026-03-15T02:12:40Z — route-mux change that increased parallel upstream connections. deploy-bot?

deploy-bot: last deploy: route-mux v3.8.1 by @jamie-eng at 2026-03-15T02:12:40Z (hash: d4f7a2). No immediate rollback triggered.

alex.sre: ok likely correlation with route-mux change. two quick mitigations: 1) enable regional fallback to reduce fanout to problematic origin nodes, 2) raise upstream circuit-breaker thresholds to avoid connection storms. I'll coordinate.

jamie-eng: i can push a soft rollback of the route-mux setting (toggle parallel_connections -> 16) if SRE wants. that will be non-disruptive.

maria-runtime: toggling fallback policy now — adding a temporary routing override to prefer origin-a instead of origin-b for eu-west. command:
```json
{ "route_override": "prefer: origin-a", "ttl": 300 }
```

ops-bot: applied route override to eu-west edges (scope: edge-*). change-id: routedev-3312.

alex.sre: running canary check on a few edges... error rate on canary down from 22% -> 9% after override. still seeing some 504s.

sara-prod: customer impact: roughly 7% of traffic (API keys flagged) saw 5xx at peak; support queue has 12 escalations so far. customer dashboard: https://ops.internal/redwood/alerts/3312345678

jamie-eng: starting soft rollback of parallel_connections flag now. command:
```bash
rbctl set route-mux.parallel_connections 16 --env prod --note "temp rollback to mitigate 502s"
```

deploy-bot: route-mux flag change queued; applying to edge config. please monitor.

alex.sre: also enabling short-term rate limit on anonymous/public routes to shed load:
```yaml
rate_limit:
  key: "anon_ip"
  requests_per_minute: 120
```

maria-runtime: rate limit applied on edge-frontend. telemetry adjusting.

incident-bot: update: partial mitigation in place. overall 5xx down to ~6% across prod in last 3m. still degraded but much improved.

ajamie-eng: typo — jamie here. confirm whether we keep rollback or coordinate a full revert?

alex.sre: keep rollback for now, leave route override for 30m. we'll handoff to morning SRE team for RCA (root cause: config increased allowed parallel upstream connections which exposed a latent capacity issue in origin pool + degraded TCP handling on some origin nodes).

sara-prod: opening a customer-facing incident note now. ETA for full root-cause investigation: 24h.

ops-bot: remind: create postmortem draft in #postmortems when stable. runbook referenced: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/gateway-502s

maria-runtime: grabbing important logs and trace samples (will upload link here). also scheduling origin-side connection drains to cycle problematic backends.

alex.sre: handoff plan — i'll add notes to the incident ticket and ping morning oncall at 08:00 UTC. post-mitigation checklist: (1) confirm error rate <1% for 1h, (2) run full traffic replay against origin pool in staging, (3) RCA doc.

jamie-eng: thanks all. if anything spikes again ping me and i'll escalate to runtime infra. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: final update: mitigation active, customer impact reduced, monitoring watch for 2h. incident severity: Sev2 -> monitoring.

alex.sre: leaving handoff summary: rolled back route-mux parallel_connections, applied regional routing override, enabled temporary rate limits, error rate fell from 22% -> 6% -> target <1% in next hour. follow-up: root cause RCA and origin TCP tuning.

sara-prod: posted customer update and support playbook. linking in ticket.

jamie-eng: creating PR for safer defaults and an automated pre-deploy traffic-sim test to catch this class of failure.

maria-runtime: uploading log bundle to the incident ticket now.

ops-bot: scheduled follow-up meeting with runtime + eng tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review RCA.

alex.sre: thanks team — moving to watch. leaving channel :white_check_mark:
